Custom development, explained

Common questions before you decide what to build.

How do we know if a custom application is the right choice?+

We review the business problem and compare a custom build with configuring existing software or improving the current workflow. The aim is a sensible investment for your requirements, not unnecessary complexity.

Can you integrate with our existing systems?+

We assess the APIs, data formats, permissions, and restrictions your systems provide. Integration feasibility and any dependencies are clarified before the relevant work is scoped.

How do you decide the technology stack?+

We consider the application’s features, expected usage, data, integrations, hosting requirements, and long-term maintenance. We discuss the trade-offs before selecting an approach.

Will the application include AI?+

Only where it serves a useful requirement. We assess the data, task, quality expectations, privacy considerations, and review process before proposing an AI feature.

How are cost, ownership, and support handled?+

The proposal defines the scope, estimate, deliverables, and commercial terms. Ownership, third-party dependencies, deployment, handover, and any ongoing support are agreed for the project.
